title: Zeus Juice Cinnabird E-Liquid 50ml Shortfill
description: Cinnabird is a uniquely delicious flavour from UK mix masters, Zeus Juice. It features a rich, buttery baked scone base with the perky, tart sweetness of fresh blueberries and a dusting of warming, comforting cinnamon. This convenient 50ml shortfill bottle comes with 10ml of free space for the addition of a nicotine shot to tailor your vape’s nicotine content to your exact preference. Its 70% VG 30% PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits , box mods and sub-ohm tanks .
